answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an AI agent economy can use cryptographic proof-of-stake tied to rare digital tokens called nectar. Creating an agent requires staking this resource, ensuring every identity has real financial backing. An attacker faces immense costs, as flooding the network with fake nodes drains their capital instantly. Like a sudden frost across a tundra, failed attacks freeze the malicious stake, leaving only a genuine economic plume of valid transactions standing.
